summary: Hafnia Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, reporting its condensed consolidated interim financial results for Q1 2026 and announcing a dividend of USD 0.2877 per share. The filing details strong earnings from transportation services amid geopolitical disruptions, fleet renewal through vessel sales, and regular dividend distribution. No special-situation event such as merger, acquisition, or restructuring is disclosed. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement by a foreign private issuer.
